Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble receiving activation code for supplier portal

Hi Karthik,

We tried to complete the supplier portal setup this morning (EcoPlastics Inc) but haven't received the 6-digit activation code via SMS or email. The onboarding link reports 'code expired' when we attempt the magic link flow. We have two users (me and onboarding@ecoplastics.com) blocked on this step.

Can you check whether the activation codes were sent or whether there's a delivery issue on your side? We need to register the bank account and upload W9 before Monday to meet our first PO.

Thanks,
Alex Ruiz
Vendor Operations Lead
EcoPlastics Inc

Hi Alex — thanks for flagging this. Short answers up front: we didn't intentionally expire codes early, and there wasn't a scheduled maintenance.

A few quick requests so we can triage fast:
- Can you confirm the phone number you entered for SMS and the exact email address used for the activation flow?
- If you have a screenshot of the 'code expired' screen, please attach.

I'm looping in Ben (platform ops) and Marissa (onboarding) so we can check delivery logs and fallback flows. I suspect either an SMS gateway retry failure or duplicate session created by the vendor portal redirect.

Next steps: Ben will look at the SMS/smtp logs and Marissa will kick a manual resend and provide a direct activation link if needed.

Karthik Iyer
Manager, Strategic Partnerships

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble receiving activation code for supplier portal

Hi Alex — quick update from Platform Ops.

Root cause summary: Between 08:45 and 09:30 PDT this morning we saw intermittent failures with our third-party SMS gateway (CarrierX) in the us-west region. Delivery attempts returned 503 for a subset of messages and our retry window exhausted before the user completed the activation flow, which presents as 'code expired'. Email delivery (smtp) shows the activation messages were queued and accepted by our provider, but some vendor mail servers (including ecoplastics.com) deferred the inbound connection which delayed receipt beyond the portal TTL.

What I did:
- Manually triggered a new activation code for alex@ecoplastics.com and onboard@ecoplastics.com (valid for 30 minutes).
- Generated a one-click fallback activation link (single-use) and put it behind a short-lived token. Link: https://app.redwood.ai/suppliers/activate?token=REDACTED
- Notified CarrierX and opened ticket CARR-9072; their status page indicates a partial outage in us-west.

Attachments: activation-instructions.pdf (PDF) — includes steps for the fallback link and guidance for corporate spam filters. Also included: sms-outage-notice.txt (log excerpt).

Suggested actions for your team:
1) Use the one-click link I just created (Alex, you should see it in your inbox — if not, check spam).
2) If SMS still doesn't arrive, use the fallback link or reply and we'll reset the TTL to 2 hours for your tenant.
3) After you log in, please upload the W9 and confirm bank account fields so we can validate the PO route.

I'll keep monitoring CarrierX and will escalate to our backup gateway if the outage continues.

Ben Carter
Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

I did see one remaining issue: when I try to view the pending PO in the 'My POs' section it shows 'No purchase orders found' even though our buyer says PO-8892 has been issued to EcoPlastics.

Could someone check that PO visibility is tied to supplier taxonomy/registration status? It looks like if the onboarding status isn't 'verified' the portal hides incoming POs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please advise next steps on PO visibility so we don't miss the payment window.
